notes.rule: certified/nearest/exactfirst as in many_tasks_analysis.py and exact_first_analysis.py; radii in arrival order, kappa 0.5, snap 1e-3 (as ruler_study.py); old ruler (whitening) with T5-base word-vectors
notes.arrival: route at arrival of task j uses only tasks 1..j and their radii (radii depend only on earlier tasks); end = all 700
notes.items: unedited inputs[:6], paraphrased inputs[:3] per pivot, as ruler_study.py / spanish_check.py; paraphrases identical to the original are kept
notes.ties: older task first (argmin / argmax over arrival order)
notes.own_at_arrival_nearest_note: under nearest the own task at arrival may be chosen by distance; under certified the oldest containing zone wins
notes.examples: 15 inputs, French/German, changed under nearest and certified for their own task under certified (certified at arrival, routed to own), spaced evenly along the list ordered by task arrival
notes.tasks_arrived_in_between: tasks that arrived after the own task and before the task that takes the input at the end (exclusive of both)
notes.by_arrival_group: five equal groups of 140 arrival positions

siblings.measure: word overlap of the two task definitions, as alike() in many_tasks_analysis.py; threshold 0.8

siblings_signature.measure: word overlap of the two task definitions, as alike() in many_tasks_analysis.py; threshold 0.8

summary_table.note: certified_at_arrival is 0 for signature and nearest (no zone certificate); exactfirst has no certificate of its own and is also given 0

sigma.definition: RMS distance of the 4000 unrelated inputs (the paper's token-weight inputs) from their own mean in psi_n = (token-weighted average of the first n tokens - mu) W; shorter inputs use all tokens

B.definition: B_k = distance from the signature of task k to the nearest signature of the unrelated tasks only (d_bg of the radius rule)
